conviction_note: The negative lean comes from the company's own documents. Q4 FY26 ended at 1.04bn yen of operating profit (about 1.52bn before a 487m yen asset-retirement charge), and same-store sales ran 96.6-98.3% from Feb to May, while Q1 FY26 had 103% June/July comparables. So Q1 probably lands below the roughly 1.65bn the flat H1 guide implies. The name has also fallen on 4 of 4 prior Q1 prints. Against that, all of this is public, consensus (7.21bn) already sits below the 7.4bn plan and the stock is down 13% since Sep 8. So p_up is only 45 on an abs_move of 5.5, giving -0.55 scaled against an impact_sum of -1.3. The gap is there because the per-finding sizes carry the lean while the scaled number carries how uncertain the sign is.
bar: Company H1 FY27/5 guide OP 2,900m yen (flat YoY), FY OP 7,400m yen (tanshin 2026-07-09, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260709/140120260709590335.pdf). Q1's own share of H1 OP was 57% in FY25 and FY26 (kabutan quarterly table), so the Q1 pace bar is about 1,650m yen OP, roughly flat on Q1 FY26's 1,673m. Analyst consensus FY OP 7,209m / ordinary 7,331m vs company 7,600m ordinary (kabuyoho, as of 2026-10-09, https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=2791). There is no Q1 consensus, so the quarterly bar is derived from the company guide. print_vs_bar_pct is my estimate of Q1 OP (~1.5bn) against that 1.65bn pace.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0% disclosed (no position at or above 0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-09-29 (baseline, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用倍率 8.54x (kabutan quote page 2026-10-13, matches baseline): leveraged retail is crowded long, the one setup where a disappointing number still finds sellers. No option skew exists. run_up_20d -9.19%, run_up_5d -1.16%; the stock is down from 4,820 (2026-09-08) to 4,195 (2026-10-09 close), about -13%. priced_lean_pct -0.006 (the margin overhang and the run-up components offset).

findings.finding: The company's own FY26 documents show it entering Q1 FY27 at a depressed run-rate. Q4 FY26 (Mar-May) OP was 1,036m yen (1.2% margin, -59.6% YoY); 487m of that year's OP hit was an asset-retirement estimate change booked in Q4 (none at Q3), so underlying Q4 was about 1.52bn. Same-store sales ran Feb 98.1 / Mar 97.2 / Apr 96.6 / May 98.3%, against Q1 FY26 comparables of Jun 103.0 / Jul 103.2 / Aug 97.8% (rice-driven). Q1 OP therefore probably lands below the ~1.65bn pace implied by the flat 2.9bn H1 guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY26 OP -36.7% YoY (36% of the H1 plan) brought -11.5% on 2025-10-15. Q3 FY26 (-48% quarter) brought -10.5% on 2026-04-13. The FY26 print with a +40% guide brought -0.9% on 2026-07-10. All from Yahoo daily closes.
findings.why_not_priced: Daikokuten publishes no 月次, so Q1 sales and margin are not visible before the print the way a monthly reporter's would be; the FY26 monthly same-store table sits only in the results presentation. The FY consensus is 2.6% below plan, not the ~10% below on Q1 pace this implies. If the market already held a weak Q1, the FY consensus would sit further below plan. Partly priced: the stock is -13% since Sep 8.
findings.independence: Second document: the FY tanshin's asset-retirement note (487m OP effect, booked in FY26 only; https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260709/140120260709590335.pdf) and kabutan's quarterly OP table (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=2791). Both are company figures, so not independent of the company. Against it: regional peer ハローズ grew Jun-Aug 2026 OP +6.0% (kabutan, https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=2742), and industry same-store sales are running about +1% (super.or.jp).

findings.finding: This name has fallen on every Q1 (Jun-Aug) print in the tape: 2022-10-14 -18.6%, 2023-10-13 -5.9%, 2024-10-11 -1.9%, 2025-10-15 -11.5% (event-day close to next close, Yahoo daily bars). Q1 is not a guidance print for this May-FY issuer, and holders appear to mark down the first look at a back-loaded plan.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Four of four Q1 reactions negative, mean -9.5%. Other prints are mixed (Apr25 +7.9, Jul25 +7.4, Jan26 -3.8, Jul26 -0.9).
findings.why_not_priced: A seasonal reaction pattern on four observations is not traded by anyone with size on a ¥174m/day name. If it were priced, the stock would rise into the Q1 print rather than drift down; it fell 13% from Sep 8, which may mean part of the pattern has been front-run.
findings.independence: None from a different source. It is a tape pattern on 4 observations, and two of the four drops coincided with genuine misses (FY23 Q1 revision, FY26 Q1 -37%).

findings.finding: The 2026-07-28 M7.1 Kumamoto earthquake hit two group stores, ラ・ムー宇城店 (Uki, a shindo-7 city) and 八代鏡店. Both ran shortened 10:00-18:00 hours until 2026-08-20/21. No TDnet damage or extraordinary-loss disclosure followed, so any disaster loss in Q1 is below materiality.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None for this name. In 2018 the company disclosed flood losses separately on TDnet; no such disclosure this time.
findings.why_not_priced: It is too small to matter: 2 of 251 stores, reduced hours for about three weeks, likely a small disaster loss below operating income. It is filed because it is a sourced fact in the quarter, not because the market missed something large.
findings.independence: Earthquake date and intensity: Kumamoto University report https://cwmd.kumamoto-u.ac.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/report_R8kumamoto_earthquake_04_rev.pdf. Kumamoto store list: https://www.dkt-s.com/search.php?pref=43 (4 stores in the prefecture).

findings.finding: FY27 openings drop to 15 from 25, with only three slotted in Q1 (Jul Osaka, Aug Fukui, Aug Yamaguchi) against five in Q1 FY26. Opening and recruitment costs in Q1 should therefore fall YoY, a partial offset to the depressed run-rate. This sits inside the company's guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean history; the FY27 guide that embeds this was met with -0.9% on 2026-07-10.
findings.why_not_priced: It is largely priced, because it is inside the guide the company published, so it is sized close to 0. What is not public is whether the three Q1 openings happened on schedule.
findings.independence: The annual report (https://www.e-dkt.co.jp/ir/pdfs/library/nenji_20260826.pdf) restates 15 openings and 15 refits for FY27. Same company, so not independent.

outside_window.finding: After the Q1 FY26 print the company announced a ToSTNeT-3 buyback a week later (2025-10-21/22), and another in April 2025. A repeat would most likely land after this window. FY26 already bought back ¥3.0bn while long-term debt rose to ¥21.5bn, which makes a repeat less likely.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: unlikely at Q1. The FY plan is back-loaded (H2 OP +91%) and the company revised at H1 in FY26, though it did revise at Q1 in FY23 (2022-10-13, the -18.6% day). Returns: dividend flat at 39 yen; no buyback has come with results at the last two equivalent prints. New-year guide: not applicable at Q1. Quarter vs own 進捗率: Q1 was 57% of H1 OP in FY25 and FY26, so ~1.65bn is on pace; my estimate is about 1.5bn.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Crowded margin long (信用倍率 8.54) as a separate negative finding
rejected_candidates.detail: Already carried in the baseline's lean_components (margin_overhang -0.466); it enters p_up via positioning_check rather than as a finding.

baseline_tension: The findings lean negative where the baseline lean is flat (-0.006): the run-up component (+0.46, stock -9% in 20 days) offsets the margin overhang. The strongest positive the release could carry: Q1 OP flat YoY against a guide that only asks for a flat H1, read as a bottoming after four quarters of -37% to -60%, on a stock at 0.93x book that has already shed 13% since Sep 8; or a buyback (the last one followed the Q1 print by a week). I looked for both and found no pre-signal of either.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a 進捗率 anyone can compute from the last 短信): finding 1 cut from -1.2 to -0.9 and p_up moved from 42 to 45. Not to 50, because this issuer publishes no 月次, so the quarter itself is not visible before the print.
Rule 2 (check the sign): wrote the strongest positive into baseline_tension (flat-H1 bar, bottoming read, possible buyback) and confirmed I had looked for it; no further change.
Other findings, abs_move_pct (5.5) and print_vs_bar_pct (-8) left unchanged.
